Bea (marketing): Quick flag for the weekly KPI deck — our March launch-post shows +CTR but total attributed MQLs down depending on the attribution model. Can we decide which number to show to execs? Screenshot: https://dash.redwood/boards/launch_metrics/snap1 :spiral_note_pad:
Zoe (growth): what's the delta between last-touch and time-decay? execs will want a single headline but we should show sensitivity.
Connor (analytics): quick numbers: last-touch = 1,024 MQLs; time-decay 14d = 1,198 MQLs; rule-based multi-touch = 1,175. So time-decay is ~17% higher than last-touch. Query: `SELECT attribution_model_counts(...)` I can paste table in a sec.
Bea (marketing): that's material. We usually report last-touch in the deck because it's stable, but that understates the launch-post impact.
Ibrahim (ops): FYI dashbot noticed a short enrichment lag on 2024-03-11 03:10 UTC; we reprocessed but annotate the board if we swap models. dashbot: enrichment window reprocessed (job reproc_20240311_0355).
Zoe (growth): two options: 1) headline uses last-touch but add a footnote with time-decay and a sensitivity band, or 2) show time-decay headline since it better captures multichannel nurture. I prefer 1 for conservative tone.
Connor (analytics): recommendation: show last-touch headline but include a single-row sensitivity bubble: "If using 14d time-decay, MQLs +17% (1,198)" and link to appendix with methodology. I'll attach the CSV.
Bea (marketing): sounds reasonable. can we also show per-channel contribution under time-decay in appendix so PMs can see the launch-post attribution share?
Connor (analytics): yes — I'll add `channel_share_time_decay.csv` to the deck.
Ibrahim (ops): ops note: if we present time-decay numbers, we must ensure there are no ingestion gaps during the window. Reproc completed but I'll add a dashboard annotation for 2024-03-11-03:00 UTC to 03:30 UTC noting the reprocess.
execbot: reminder Weekly KPI deck due Friday 09:00 PT.
Zoe (growth): Bea, I'll draft two single-line options for the headline and you can pick. Proposed text A (conservative): "Launch-post drove 1,024 MQLs (last-touch); see appendix for multi-touch sensitivity (+17%)." Proposed text B (impact-forward): "Launch-post contributed ~1,198 MQLs (14d time-decay)."
Bea (marketing): let's go with A and include a 1-slide appendix showing both models and channel shares. Also add a one-sentence note explaining why time-decay differs: attribution window and touch weighting.
Connor (analytics): will prepare appendix with methodology note: `time-decay half-life = 3d, window = 14d, touch weight proportional to recency` and a csv export link: https://internal.jobs/exports/launch_attrib_models_202403.csv
Zoe (growth): great. Also recommend we standardize attribution sensitivity in the KPIs doc so we don't get repeated questions. I'll add to the doc template.
Bea (marketing): perfect. thanks everyone — saving deck as "WK14 KPI - last-touch headline, appendix sensitivity" and will send to execs after Connor attaches the appendix. :raised_hands:
